description: Defines a custom implementation of a string_view class with C++20-like methods, including string manipulation, comparison, and search functionalities, along with related utility functions and hash specialization.

classes.name: basic_string_view
classes.description: A custom implementation mimicking std::string_view with additional methods for string operations.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access character at position with bounds checking.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Access character at position with range checking.

methods.description: Check if string view is empty.

methods.description: Compare with another string view or string.

methods.description: Check if string ends with suffix or character.
